inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: May not record, listen to, or eavesdrop on any Licensing interview or internal discussion: Based on information provided parts of interviews conducted with staff and children by licensing privately were listened to by management staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: May not record, listen to, or eavesdrop on any Licensing interview or internal discussion (26 TAC §745.8485(a))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: At time of inspection, one caregiver changed a child's diaper without gloves. Caregiver was observed not washing their hands after the diaper change before going to the next diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: At time of inspection, one caregiver observed providing care for children did not have a background check with eligibilty results. Another caregiver in the same class was providing care for children whose background check was entered incorrectly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: During the inspection, the operational policies were viewed and the following information was missing:  (11) Immunization requirements for children, including tuberculosis screening and   testing if required by your regional Texas Department of State Health Services   or local health authority  (20) Parent rights that are consistent with the rules in Division 5 of this subchapter   (relating to Parent Rights)  (23) Instructions on how a parent may access the [Medium]:  (A) Minimum standards online;   (B) Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline; and  (C) HHSC website.    (24) Your emergency preparedness plan   (28) Information on vaccine-preventable diseases for employees, unless your center is in the   home of the permit holder. The policy must address the requirements outlined in   ?746.3611 of this chapter (relating to What must a policy for protecting children from   vaccine-preventable diseases include?)  (29) If your operation maintains and administers unassigned epinephrine auto- injectors to use   when a child in care has an emergency anaphylaxis reaction, policies for maintenance,   administration, and disposal of unassigned epinephrine auto-injectors that comply with the   unassigned epinephrine auto- injector requirements set by the Texas Department of State   Health Services, as specified in 25 TAC Chapter 40, Subchapter C (relating to Epinephrine   Auto- Injector Policies in Youth Facilities) and in Texas Health and Safety Code ?773.0145.  (30) (b)You must also inform the parents that any area within 1,000 feet of a child-care center is a   gang-free zone, where criminal offenses related to organized criminal activity are subject to a   harsher penalty under the Texas Penal Code. You may inform the parents by: [Low]  (A) Providing this information in the operational policies;  (B) Distributing the information in writing to the parents; or  (C) Informing the parents verbally as part of an individual or group parent orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: During the inspection, the director file was viewed and had no annual training hours for the calendar year 2024-2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: During the inspection, 10 children files viewed did not have emergency medical informaiton available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: During the inspection, the transportation binder did not have emergency medical information available for review for the children being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: During the inspection, there were 6 out of 10 files viewed that did not have their required 24 hours of traning for the calendar year 2024-2025. There were 2  staff with 16.5 annual training hours, 1 staff with 20 annual training hours, 1 staff with 19 annual training hours, 1 staff with 11 annual training hours and 1 staff with 12 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 Survey data from January 17, 2025, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The director file was reviewed and first aid had expired on 11/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Director file was reviwed and CPR had expired 11/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: A child was dropped off at 9am and diaper wasn't changed until 12:45pm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the inspection, I observed disinfect wipes accessible to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The annual fire inspection has not been conducted. The last inspection was conducted on 11/1/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The black plastic playground border on the school age playground is cracked and missing a bolt.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Inappropriate discipline was used with a child in care when an employee grabbed a child's hand hard enough to bruise the child's hand.     Note: The employee was terminated immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: Two caregivers did not know the ages of the students in the toddler classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: One infant was observed in a chair without the required straps.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, the caregivers did not maintain supervision in the toddler classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Based on the information obtained during the investigation,  there was sufficient evidence to indicate parents were not notified of injuries received.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: One student record was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person: Based on external documentation, the identify of a parent was not recorded during pick up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §746.4103(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, there was sufficient evidence to indicate the toddler classroom was out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: Based on external documentation, two caregivers did not receive training in biting to meet the needs of the classroom with biters.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, curriculum is not followed in the toddler classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, the caregivers did not maintain supervision allowing a child to be bitten.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver was allowed to have direct access to the children in care before a complete background check eligibility was received.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: One student in the threes class was observed not washing hands after using restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: One caregiver did not have proof of education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: One student record was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- signed dated statement that employee attended abuse/neglect training: One caregiver did not have the abuse/neglect training signed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation a caregiver used inappropriate discipline in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, parents were not notified of inappropriate discipline in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: One caregiver was observed making a bottle next to the diaper changing pad.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §746.3503(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: One infant did not have the required infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One caregiver did not have the required in person First Aid/CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The changing pad located in the twos classroom was observed torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There was one caregiver caring for 16 children in the morning drop off room. The specified age group was three years old, which makes the room over ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained the caregivers are not demonstrating competency, good judgment, and self-control while placing students to sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: Based on information received there is a sufficient amount of evidence to suggest that a child was forced to sleep during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver in the toddler room, who was caring for children, did not have an eligible result from CBCU.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, updated lesson plans were not posted in the toddler and preschool classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, an ineligible contractor was allowed at the operation for maintenance work on March 9th.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Adult-sized Chair (26 TAC §746.2405(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, caregivers are not changing students in a timely manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, caregivers in the infant classroom were using the sink to wash bottles and hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment: The toilet in the two's and three classrooms contained excrement on the toilet. The wall in the two's classroom had excrement smeared on the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: Two caregivers in the toddler classrooms did not know an accurate age of children they were responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The toddler mats were observed to be lacking labels.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The base board in the school age classroom was peeling off of the wall on the left and right side of the room. A wall plug was also observed to be hanging off of the wall.    SN: Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
